title: 報警 / 求助
description: 向警察或他人求助的用語

sentences.en: I need to report a theft that occurred approximately twenty minutes ago near the entrance of the shopping mall on Park Street.
sentences.zh: 我需要報告大約二十分鐘前在公園街購物中心入口附近發生的一起竊盜案。

sentences.en: Someone grabbed my bag and ran away while I was waiting at the crosswalk, and I would like to file an official police report.
sentences.zh: 有人在我等紅綠燈時搶了我的包就跑，我想要提出正式的報案。

sentences.en: Could you please direct me to the nearest police station where I can report an incident that happened to me earlier this evening?
sentences.zh: 能否請你指引我最近的警察局，我要報告今天傍晚發生在我身上的一件事？

sentences.en: I witnessed a car accident at the intersection involving two vehicles, and I believe the injured passengers inside need immediate assistance.
sentences.zh: 我目睹了路口兩輛車的交通事故，我認為車內受傷的乘客需要立即協助。

sentences.en: The man who stole my wallet was wearing a dark hoodie and jeans, and he ran in the direction of the subway station after taking it.
sentences.zh: 偷我皮夾的人穿著深色帽T和牛仔褲，拿了之後往地鐵站方向跑了。

sentences.en: I am a foreign tourist and I do not speak the local language, so I would appreciate it if there is an officer who can communicate in English.
sentences.zh: 我是外國遊客，不會說當地語言，如果有能用英語溝通的警員，我會很感激。

sentences.en: My hotel room was broken into while I was out sightseeing today, and several valuable items including my laptop have been taken.
sentences.zh: 我今天出去觀光時旅館房間被闖入了，包括筆電在內的幾件貴重物品被拿走了。

sentences.en: I feel very unsafe in this area because a group of people has been following me for the last three blocks, and I need help immediately.
sentences.zh: 我在這個區域感到非常不安全，因為有一群人在過去三個街區一直跟著我，我需要立即幫助。

sentences.en: There is a suspicious person loitering near the school entrance who has been trying to talk to the children, and I think someone should investigate.
sentences.zh: 有一個可疑的人在學校入口附近徘徊，一直試圖和孩子們說話，我認為應該有人去調查。

sentences.en: I would like to know the process for obtaining a police report, which I need to submit to my travel insurance company for my stolen belongings.
sentences.zh: 我想了解取得警察報告的流程，我需要它提交給旅遊保險公司申報被盜物品。

sentences.en: The person who assaulted me was approximately six feet tall with short brown hair, and the incident took place near the fountain in the park.
sentences.zh: 攻擊我的人大約六英尺高，棕色短髮，事件發生在公園噴泉附近。

sentences.en: I noticed that someone has been tampering with the lock on my car door, and there are scratch marks around the keyhole that were not there before.
sentences.zh: 我注意到有人在撬我車門的鎖，鑰匙孔周圍有之前沒有的刮痕。

sentences.en: My passport was pickpocketed on the crowded bus this morning, and I need a police report so that my embassy can issue me an emergency travel document.
sentences.zh: 今天早上在擁擠的公車上護照被扒走了，我需要報案證明，這樣大使館才能核發緊急旅行文件。

sentences.en: I am reporting a case of fraud in which someone used a fake website to trick me into providing my credit card information.
sentences.zh: 我要報告一起詐騙案，有人用假網站騙我提供了信用卡資訊。

sentences.en: There is a man standing outside my apartment building who has been shouting threats and banging on the main entrance door for the past fifteen minutes.
sentences.zh: 有一個男人站在我公寓大樓外面，過去十五分鐘一直在叫囂威脅並猛敲大門。

sentences.en: I was involved in a minor dispute with a street vendor who refused to return my money after selling me a counterfeit product.
sentences.zh: 我和一個攤販起了小糾紛，他賣了假貨給我卻拒絕退錢。

sentences.en: Could you please help me contact my country's embassy, because I have lost all my identification documents and money due to the robbery?
sentences.zh: 能否請你幫我聯繫我國家的大使館？因為搶劫讓我丟失了所有身分證件和錢。

sentences.en: I heard what sounded like gunshots coming from the building across the street, and I think the police should be notified about this right away.
sentences.zh: 我聽到像是從對街大樓傳來的槍聲，我認為應該立刻通知警察。

sentences.en: The scam artist who tricked me was posing as a tour guide, and he took my payment before disappearing into the crowd without providing any service.
sentences.zh: 騙我的詐騙犯假裝是導遊，收了我的錢之後就消失在人群中，什麼服務都沒提供。

sentences.en: I would like to report a case of harassment that has been occurring repeatedly at my workplace, and I have messages as evidence to show the officers.
sentences.zh: 我想報告一起在我工作場所反覆發生的騷擾案件，我有訊息紀錄作為證據給警員看。

sentences.en: After realizing my rental car had been vandalized overnight in the parking lot, I immediately came to the station to file a complaint.
sentences.zh: 發現我的租車一夜之間在停車場被破壞後，我立刻來警局報案。

sentences.en: Is it possible to get a copy of the incident report in English, since I will need to present it to my insurance company back in my home country?
sentences.zh: 有沒有可能拿到英文版的事件報告？因為我回國後需要交給保險公司。

sentences.en: I was walking home late at night when two individuals on a motorcycle snatched my bag from my shoulder and sped away before I could react.
sentences.zh: 我深夜走路回家時，兩個騎摩托車的人從我肩上搶走了包包，我還來不及反應他們就加速離開了。

sentences.en: The neighbor living in the apartment above mine has been making death threats, and I have recorded several voicemails as proof of the intimidation.
sentences.zh: 住在我樓上的鄰居一直在發出死亡威脅，我已錄下幾段語音留言作為恐嚇的證據。

sentences.en: I believe my drink was tampered with at the bar last night, because I only had one glass yet felt extremely dizzy and disoriented afterwards.
sentences.zh: 我相信昨晚在酒吧我的飲料被下了東西，因為我只喝了一杯卻感到極度暈眩和意識模糊。

sentences.en: Someone broke the window of our parked car and stole the bags from the back seat while we were inside the museum visiting the exhibition.
sentences.zh: 我們在博物館看展覽時，有人打破我們停著的車的車窗，偷了後座的包包。

sentences.en: I need police assistance because a taxi driver refused to let me out of the vehicle and demanded a fare that was three times higher than normal.
sentences.zh: 我需要警察協助，因為一個計程車司機不讓我下車，而且要求的車資是正常的三倍。

sentences.en: The officer who took my statement said the investigation might take several weeks, during which I should remain reachable at my contact number.
sentences.zh: 做筆錄的警員說調查可能需要幾週時間，期間我應該保持聯絡電話暢通。

sentences.en: I discovered that my identity has been stolen and used to open bank accounts in another city, which is why I am here to report this crime.
sentences.zh: 我發現我的身分被盜用並在另一個城市開了銀行帳戶，所以我來這裡報案。

sentences.en: Please help me; there is a fight happening right outside this store, and one of the people involved appears to be carrying a weapon.
sentences.zh: 請幫幫我，這家店外面正在打架，其中一個人似乎攜帶了武器。
